designer_notes: Intro for OB04: a 3x3 dew seed in the centre of an open board (all four corners trimmed), so most early matches through the middle rows and columns start on dew and spread it. No blockers, so nothing distracts from the one goal (0% blocked). This replaces the plan's 'blocker band' shape, because a band would need non-goal obstacles on an intro. Goal 51 = 66% of 77 playable cells (9 seeds count from the start, 42 new cells needed). Plan values kept (30 moves, OB04 x51).
